contract: every cost-model row ever recorded, APPEND-ONLY and in the order recorded, INCLUDING the rows whose prediction has no measurement yet. Every figure carries a basis: measured, fitted, predicted or extrapolated. A `measured_` field holds ONLY a measured figure and a `predicted_` field NEVER holds one -- a row that violates either is a schema error, not a caveat. Peak allocated and peak resident are separate columns and are not comparable (see grobner::external::contract::RssBasis). Prediction error is DERIVED from the predicted and measured columns; the stored `derived` object is a convenience and is recomputed on load. A re-measurement is a new row with a new commit, never an edit to an old one.
